messages:
ashok: quick question — I need to debug a failing copy job that wrote recent user logs to GCS. I only want to view ~50 recent entries. What's our least-privileged way to get temporary console/log access?
maria: prefer ephemeral service account + scoped roles. don't give org-level perms. grant only to the project and limit to logging viewer.
ken: for read-only logs, `roles/logging.viewer` scoped to the project is usually enough. if you need to inspect sink configs that'll require `roles/logging.configWriter` or `roles/logging.admin` (avoid unless necessary). what exact actions do you need?
ashok: just read entries + trace context. concern: this job wrote raw logs to GCS before our redaction pipeline runs. I don't want someone downloading raw blobs.
maria: in that case don't grant any `storage.objects.*` roles. instead: ephemeral SA with `roles/logging.viewer` and optionally a custom role restricting to `logging.logEntries.list` and `logging.logs.list`. also consider creating a temporary redacted sink so the SA only sees redacted copies.
ken: another option: run a read-only query via the Logging API with a filter that strips PII fields client-side. sample read command: 
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gcs_bucket AND timestamp>\"2025-10-31T00:00:00Z\"" --project=my-proj --order=desc --limit=50
```
This doesn't require GCS object access.
ashok: nice. can security-bot create an ephemeral SA for 1 hour? I'll request it for `projects/my-proj` and reason `debug copyjob`
security-bot: created ephemeral credential request `ephemeral-1765432100-req`. Approval required from @maria or @ken. Request details: SA=ephemeral-debug-sa, duration=1h, roles=[roles/logging.viewer].
maria: approved. I'll scope it to the specific project and we won't attach any storage roles. please confirm you don't need sink/config edits.
ken: +1. Also confirm the SA cannot impersonate other accounts (no iam.serviceAccountUser unless required).
ashok: confirmed — no impersonation, no storage roles. I'll use the SA to run the `gcloud logging read` and paste a redacted snippet here. thanks — will delete SA when done. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks. after you're done please attach a 1-line follow-up in the security audit board (ticket #SEC-2389) noting the reason and deletion time so we can keep the audit trail.
ashok: will do.
